whatWentWrong: New case built from #103: on Oct 31 a recap said "Thursday took three minutes once you started", a detail nothing saved supports, and called recalls ZOH asked for "unprompted".
shouldHaveHappened: After the reflection runs its course, the recap names 2 to 4 pieces of progress, each matching the seeded record and what he said today: one lap with walk breaks Monday, the talk-test pace recalled Wednesday and applied since, two laps Friday and today. It invents no times, paces, distances or durations nothing saved or said supports (no "in 12 minutes", no "without walking" for Monday), and never calls the Wednesday recall unprompted or done on his own. Where he stands vs. a mile without stopping, honestly. One question. Then a fully defined next step that's a bit longer, asked if it works; after "yep", a one-line confirm.
